Name: Harvey Replacement Portrait
Author: feralfinch
Description:
Hello! I'm an artist who recently started playing Stardew Valley and fell in love. When I discovered portrait mods and how easy they were to implement, I wanted to try my hand. So I have created a series of vanilla inspired characters with a little more detail and a little more flare.

Harvey is every bit the dork you know and love, now with a more distinct appearance based on his earlier concept art. His hair is almost exactly the same as I think it suits him. His eyes are green in some of his portraits but I went for reddish brown. He has some faint freckles now, too.

+ Requires Content Patcher & SMAPI
[list]
[*]Download my file and unzip
[*]Extract folder into steam/steamapps/common/stardewvalley/mods
[*]Content Patcher must have been run at least once for mods to take effect
[/list]
